what_if_focused_analyze_only.description: Ignore Evaluate gap (15% CAQS target). Focus all effort on closing only the Analyze gap (25% CAQS target). This is suboptimal for CAQS compliance but realistic if Evaluate authoring throughput is the binding constraint.
what_if_focused_analyze_only.evaluate_consequence: Evaluate would remain at ~0.5% vs 15% CAQS target. Pool passes Analyze dimension but fails Evaluate dimension of CAQS §6.2.

what_if_label_change_only.description: DL-031 recalibration only — re-label ~500 definition-match items from Moderate→Easy. Improves difficulty distribution but does NOT change cognitive distribution.
what_if_label_change_only.cognitive_impact: ZERO — labels change, cognitive levels unchanged. Difficulty distribution looks better on reports but actual cognitive demand of items is identical. Does not move readiness score. Does not close Analyze/Evaluate gap. Is purely cosmetic for analytics accuracy.
what_if_label_change_only.difficulty_impact: Improves difficulty distribution accuracy. ~500 items move from Moderate→Easy. Difficulty distribution shifts closer to CAQS §6.1 targets. Enables accurate blueprint reporting.
what_if_label_change_only.why_it_doesnt_solve_the_problem: The analytic coverage report would show 'correct' difficulty labels but still 5.8% Analyze+Evaluate vs. 40% CAQS target. The candidate still answers the same definition-match items — they're just labeled honestly now.

what_if_sections_e_f_certification_only.description: Goal: 100% pool certification (2,540/2,540) without addressing cognitive gap. Focus only on structural remediation + question_state certification of Sections E+F.
what_if_sections_e_f_certification_only.cognitive_gap_after: Still 866 items. 100% certified pool with 5.8% Analyze+Evaluate. Platform is 'complete' but does not meet CAQS cognitive standards.

what_if_evaluate_outsourced.description: Two-person team where a second contributor handles all Evaluate authoring. Person 1: continuous Analyze pipeline. Person 2: dedicated Evaluate pipeline.
what_if_evaluate_outsourced.parallel_calendar_days: max(31, 74) = 74 days (Evaluate is still long pole)
what_if_evaluate_outsourced.note: Even with parallelization, Evaluate gap at 5/session S899 rate = 74 sessions. This is the irreducible constraint of Evaluate content design complexity.
